method: case-sensitive comparison of the model's top-1 token with the word that follows the same 3-6 word context (case and punctuation ignored for the context) in each other manuscript copy; teacher-forced recall from the recorded artifact
caveats: One passage. Exploratory: it shows which misses coincide with another authentic wording, not why the model produced them.
Transcriptions of the copies come from one secondary source and differ in punctuation.
A prediction that matches another copy may still have other causes (for example, the same phrase in quotations or paraphrases seen in training).
